'''N4''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was owned by the [[near-Human]] [[Gern Zott]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It consisted of a hollow [[Battle droid/Legends|military droid]] shell that Zott had attempted to make look intimidating, by fitting it with [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]] and a small power supply. He also attached some broom handles to it, which he had painted black to make them look like [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Zott was hired by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Krol-Pek]] to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] and pick up the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Salld Nrump]], and he flew there in his [[YT-1760 small transport/Legends|YT-1760 transport]] ''[[The Panada's Kiss|Panada's Kiss]]'', accompanied by N4.
